title: Keep animation curves from blending in montages
description:
Unreal for Animators workshop at iAnimate: https://ianimate.net/workshops/unreal-for-animators

Montage blending ruining your animation curve values? Divide the curve by a metadata curve and the value stays exact until the montage ends. Great for additive corrections and IK.

Full tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CYHdjr9YwV0
